mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO cash_service_points (serve_bank, serve_anchor, serve_anchor_addr, service_type, serve_point_name, serve_point_addr, chosen_position, duty_name, duty_phone, constructing_mode, constructing_case, start_time, service_mode, publishing_device, exchange_money_count, exchange_money_number, money_total, lqb_money_total, strokes_total, lqb_strokes_total, money_total_accumulative, lqb_money_total_accumulative, scrapped_conversion_money, a_scrapped_conversion_money, remark, created_time, updated_time) VALUES
(#{item.serveBank}, #{item.serveAnchor}, #{item.serveAnchorAddr}, #{item.serviceType}, #{item.servePointName}, #{item.servePointAddr}, #{item.chosenPosition}, #{item.dutyName}, #{item.dutyPhone}, #{item.constructingMode}, #{item.constructingCase}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.serviceMode}, #{item.publishingDevice}, #{item.exchangeMoneyCount}, #{item.exchangeMoneyNumber}, #{item.moneyTotal}, #{item.lqbMoneyTotal}, #{item.strokesTotal}, #{item.lqbStrokesTotal}, #{item.moneyTotalAccumulative}, #{item.lqbMoneyTotalAccumulative}, #{item.scrappedConversionMoney}, #{item.aScrappedConversionMoney}, #{item.remark}, now(), now() )
mapper.sql: select csp.a_scrapped_conversion_money, csp.chosen_position, csp.constructing_case, csp.constructing_mode, csp.created_time, csp.duty_name, csp.duty_phone, csp.exchange_money_count, csp.exchange_money_number, csp.grid_code, csp.grid_name, csp.lat, csp.lon, csp.id, csp.lqb_money_total, csp.lqb_money_total_accumulative, csp.lqb_strokes_total, csp.money_total, csp.money_total_accumulative, csp.publishing_device, csp.remark, csp.scrapped_conversion_money, csp.serve_anchor, csp.serve_anchor_addr, csp.serve_bank, csp.serve_point_addr, csp.serve_point_name, csp.service_mode, csp.service_type, csp.start_time, csp.strokes_total, csp.updated_time
mapper.select: from cash_service_points csp left join pa_addr_info_type pait on csp.grid_code = pait.code where ancestor_codes like concat('%,', #{gridCode},',%')

select count(1) as total from cash_service_points csp left join pa_addr_info_type pait on csp.grid_code = pait.code where
ancestor_codes like concat('%,', #{gridCode},',%')
